data.name: Glacier Bay National Park Visitor Center
data.description: OPEN on the second floor of Glacier Bay Lodge in Bartlett Cove, 10 miles from Gustavus. Staffed daily in summer with park rangers. Stop by for exhibits, park information, trip planning, bookstore, reading area, hydrophone kiosk, interpretive programs, park films, brochures, and much more.
data.passportStampLocationDescription: An NPS passport stamp will be available at the Glacier Bay Visitor Center (located in the Glacier Bay Lodge) when a park ranger is present staffing the desk. Check hours on the park's basic information page.
data.directionsInfo: Located in Bartlett Cove, upstairs in the Glacier Bay Lodge.

operatingHours.description: The Glacier Bay National Park Visitor Center, located on the second floor of the Glacier Bay Lodge, is open daily during the summer season (Memorial Day to Labor Day). Please note the Visitor Center desk is staffed from 11 AM to 5:30 PM. View natural and cultural history exhibits on the second floor of the lodge while the lodge is open, 6 AM to 10 PM (Note: 2025 hours for the lodge have not yet been reported by the park's commercial partner who operates the lodge).
operatingHours.name: Glacier Bay National Park Visitor Center

data.name: Visitor Information Station - Backcountry Office
data.description: Located near the head of the public-use dock in Bartlett Cove, 10 miles from Gustavus. The "VIS" provides trip planning information, boating and camping permits, and offers boater/camper orientation sessions for visitors heading into the wild backcountry of Glacier Bay. Stop by and meet a park ranger. Open annually between May and September.
data.directionsInfo: Located near the head of the public dock in Bartlett Cove, 10 miles from the town of Gustavus.

operatingHours.description: The Visitor Information Station (VIS) is open each summer between May and September for trip planning, park information, and boating & camper permits. Stop by and start your Glacier Bay adventure.
